title: Title & Registration Services Lender Courier Charge on a Packet Returned for Lien Information
content:
When a returned Title & Registration Services packet goes back to the state, a lender courier charge is added: twelve dollars (12.00) when an outside lender's proceeds were posted to the purchase order and the state has returned the order for a lien information error, six dollars (6.00) when only Kestrel Auto Finance proceeds were posted and such a return stands, and nothing otherwise. Kestrel funds this charge itself and adds it to the same remittance.

## Records read

- the payment entries on the purchase order ledger under Vehicle Purchase Agreements, by source of funds (outside lender proceeds, Kestrel finance proceeds);
- the state rejection entries on the title order whose reason is lien information error.

| Lien information error return on the order | Outside lender proceeds posted | Kestrel Auto Finance proceeds posted | Lender courier charge |
|---|---|---|---|
| yes | yes | either | 12.00 |
| yes | no | yes | 6.00 |
| yes | no | no | nothing |
| no | either | either | nothing |

## Hypothetical illustrations

- An order financed through Kestrel Auto Finance, returned once for a lien information error: 6.00.
- An order financed by an outside lender, returned only for a missing signature: nothing.
